_meta.beschreibung: Case-study data of the Promptotyping methodology site. The sources are the case descriptions in the vault, the method extensions in the Promptotyping MOC and the project inventory in Pollin 2026, Section 5.2. The useCase values are an ordering grid of the site's own; the paper orders the projects by the interface typology of Section 4.2.
_meta.kuratierung: Curated selection of the publicly presentable projects, short of the full evidence corpus of the paper. Excluded for want of client clearance, or because they are a teaching format rather than a research artefact, are vetmedai-wissensbilanz, agentic-edition-pipeline, wiiw-patent-analysis, wiiw-figaro-subagents, sugw, vault-kuration-screencast, wissensorganisation-nano-banana and wissens-projektmanagement-obsidian-claude-code-screencast. The gallery follows an ordering grid of its own and does not mirror the evidence corpus of the paper. It therefore also carries the Aldersbach monastic accounts, which were taken out of the paper because the case is too old; the case stays here because it carries didactically and the gallery is curated rather than complete (operator decision 2026-07-25). The case diged-neolat with the display name Lucina Digital Edition was removed from the gallery on 2026-07-26, because the paper text deliberately does not carry it (operator decision 2026-07-26).

schema.id: anchor slug, forming the site anchor together with #case- (e.g. herdata -> #case-herdata)
schema.name: display name
schema.useCase: exactly one of: data-production, data-modelling-capture, workflow-construction, data-rescue-transformation, data-exploration, knowledge-infrastructure, process-visualisation, literature-review-infrastructure, origin-point
schema.interfaceTypes: array of verification, exploration, edition, capture, audit; empty where none is documented (from the interface-type column of the project inventory, Pollin 2026, Section 5.2)
schema.insight: methodological contribution per the project inventory (Pollin 2026, Section 5.2), otherwise null
schema.deep_page: true for the seven deep pages, otherwise false

caseStudies.name: teiCrafter
caseStudies.summary: Hackathon prototype (2023) that showed an LLM can produce TEI-XML from transcribed texts and that triggered the development of Promptotyping as a structured method.
caseStudies.insight: Origin point (2023), vibe coding without a method

caseStudies.name: Stefan Zweig Digital Annotation Tool
caseStudies.summary: First publicly documented Promptotyping experiment, a timeline-based annotation tool for correspondence data from Stefan Zweig Digital, built in about two hours.
caseStudies.data: XML correspondence metadata from Stefan Zweig Digital
caseStudies.artifact: Timeline annotation tool as a single page application
caseStudies.insight: Critical Expert in the Loop (two-hour experiment, first blog post)

caseStudies.name: SZD-HTR OCR Pipeline
caseStudies.summary: VLM-based HTR/OCR pipeline for the Stefan Zweig estate at the Literaturarchiv Salzburg, demonstrating Promptotyping at production scale across numerous documented sessions.
caseStudies.data: Digitised estate (correspondence, life documents, works, essay files)
caseStudies.artifact: HTR/OCR pipeline with facsimile-text viewer and statistics dashboard

caseStudies.name: DEPCHA Aldersbach Dashboard
caseStudies.summary: Interactive dashboard for exploring historical financial transactions of the Cistercian abbey of Aldersbach following the DEPCHA data model.

caseStudies.name: CVMA Stained Glass Annotation Tool
caseStudies.summary: Scholarly annotation tool for medieval stained-glass artefacts from the Corpus Vitrearum Medii Aevi, with SPARQL-based extraction from the NFDI4Culture knowledge graph.

caseStudies.name: imareal-room-object
caseStudies.summary: Dashboard for exploring medieval room inventories from the REALonline database for the study of material culture.
caseStudies.insight: Context memory, journal plus git history for session resumption

caseStudies.name: Hans Gross Kriminalmuseum Digital Archive
caseStudies.summary: Digital archive of the criminological collection with two interface paradigms, traditional search and canvas-based spatial exploration.
caseStudies.insight: Dual paradigm, search plus canvas-based spatial exploration

caseStudies.name: CorrespExplorer
caseStudies.summary: Full research tool for the interactive visualisation of correspondence metadata in CMIF format across twelve coordinated views.
caseStudies.insight: First complete document set of the corpus, with journal and test suite

caseStudies.name: HerData
caseStudies.summary: Static web application for the prosopographical visualisation of Goethe's female correspondents, with an explicit reflection on map bias ahead of use.
caseStudies.insight: Gender-focused network with a map-bias transparency section

caseStudies.name: coOCR-HTR
caseStudies.summary: Browser-based workbench for expert-in-the-loop transcription workflows that renders OCR/HTR outputs beside the source images; prototyped in a single working day.
caseStudies.insight: Prototype under a regression suite; the only community fork in the corpus (OEAW)

caseStudies.name: Kulturpool Explorer
caseStudies.summary: Static collection interface for around 19,000 objects from the Kulturpool API, built with parallel agent orchestration.
caseStudies.insight: Parallel agent orchestration (2 Claude Code instances)

caseStudies.name: M3GIM
caseStudies.summary: Digital collection and multi-view exploration of the Ira Malaniuk archive, where the interface makes the limits of the still-developing data model visible.
caseStudies.insight: The data model develops through the interface, carried by a decision register

caseStudies.name: ZBZ OCR/TEI Pipeline
caseStudies.summary: LLM-supported OCR and TEI pipeline for the Jeanne Hersch papers at the Zentralbibliothek Zuerich, the most extensive Promptotyping example with a full epistemic infrastructure.
caseStudies.artifact: Curated TEI-XML edition with verification interfaces
caseStudies.insight: Full pipeline infrastructure with one verification interface per stage

caseStudies.name: Notker Edition
caseStudies.summary: Digital edition of the Notker psalm commentary (Psalm 2) that makes interwoven text layers individually visible and controllable through orthogonal toggles.
caseStudies.insight: Layer-toggle edition, orthogonal text-layer controls, IIIF, TEI-first

caseStudies.name: Klawiter Bibliography Rescue
caseStudies.summary: Extraction and restructuring of the Klawiter bibliography from a decommissioned MediaWiki database into structured JSON-LD with a static web front end.
caseStudies.artifact: JSON-LD bibliography plus static front end (SZD ecosystem)
caseStudies.insight: Data rescue, staged pipeline plus curation interface under a test suite

caseStudies.name: FemPrompt SozArb
caseStudies.summary: Systematic literature review on AI literacy and LLM bias in social work, with a five-stage pipeline and a dual assessment design between human experts and an LLM.
caseStudies.insight: Beyond DH, literature review infrastructure with a generated knowledge base

caseStudies.name: Austrian University Dashboard
caseStudies.summary: Interactive dashboard for Austrian university statistics that runs through every phase of the method on video as a teaching baseline.
